items.label: 【High-Quality Material】
items.value: LOMON v neck womens summer tops are made of soft and comfortable fabric,the breathable and lightweight fabric is perfect for spring, summer ,fall.Can be worn tucked or untucked with leggings,makes you a stylish and trendy casual everyday look

items.label: 【Design】
items.value: LOMON spring tops for women are feture trendy V-neck, elegant puff sleeve ,casual short sleeve, solid color and floral color.it as soft to the touch with a comfortable, cozy feel

items.label: 【Casual & Busniess】
items.value: LOMON spring summer tops are perfect for casual and business occasion.It's perfect for professional settings and can be worn with a blazer for a more polished look. The puff sleeves add a sweet, feminine touch that's perfect for casual meetups

items.label: 【Occasions】
items.value: Beach vacation and casual dinners – Dresses up easily with shorts or a skirt for seaside restaurants. Summer picnics or barbecues – Lightweight fabric keeps you cool while looking polished. Market trips – Comfortable for walking around but stylish enough for photos. Casual family gatherings – Nice enough for family photos but comfortable for long conversations. Running errands, Coffee dates with friends, Book club meetings, Brunch with girlfriends

items.label: 【Garment Care】
items.value: Machine wash or hand wash in cold weater, no bleach. Please check the LOMON size chart carefully before ordering
